# Map document

Entry text links [the spec](SPEC.md).

## 1. Uses

Read [the spec](SPEC.md) first, then [the spec](SPEC.md), "The walk" for detail.
A wrapped quote: [the spec](SPEC.md),
"The walk" opens this line.
Unmapped heading: [the spec](SPEC.md), "No such heading" goes to the entry point.
With a fragment [spec](SPEC.md#x) drops it; [notes](notes.md#keep) keeps it.

### Nested use

From deeper: [the spec](SPEC.md) "The walk" and [notes](notes.md).
